title: Skyline Rush — Reliability
description: Crash-free session rate, API error rate by path, and outbox-flush success rate. Implements 12_ANALYTICS_AND_OBSERVABILITY.md §Dashboards bullet 4. API error rate is real; crash-free rate and outbox-flush rate both come from aggregated client telemetry that this prototype does not ingest and are marked placeholder rather than approximated with a server-side stand-in.

panels.title: API error rate (5xx share, 5m)
panels.description: Share of gateway responses returning 5xx. Path labels are cardinality-guarded: unrouted requests are labelled path="unmatched" rather than echoing the raw URL (CLAUDE.md §8, RED-210).

panels.title: Average request duration
panels.description: http_request_duration_seconds is exported as a gauge of the rolling mean (see the /metrics handler), not a histogram, so no quantile can be derived from it. Treat as a trend indicator only.

panels.title: Unmatched-path request rate
panels.description: Traffic hitting no registered route. Watches both for scanning activity and for a client shipping a stale URL. Also the visible proof that the cardinality guard is active.

panels.title: Error rate by route
panels.description: Per-route 4xx and 5xx breakdown, for isolating which endpoint regressed.

panels.title: Crash-free session rate by release
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_client_sessions_total and skyline_client_crashed_sessions_total come from the aggregated Unity crash-telemetry pipeline described in 12_ANALYTICS_AND_OBSERVABILITY.md §Logs/traces, which this repo does not ingest. Backs the SkylineCrashFreeSessionRateBelowTarget alert. Renders No Data until that pipeline exists.

panels.title: Outbox flush success rate (client telemetry)
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_client_outbox_flush_total{result} is a CLIENT-side concept. The offline outbox lives entirely on device (10_OFFLINE_SYNC_AND_STORAGE.md); the server cannot observe a flush that never left the device, so no server-side substitute is offered here. The nearest real server signal is skyline_idempotent_replay_total on the Economy Health dashboard. RF-07 scope caveat: that counter is NOT an outbox metric. It counts server-side idempotent-replay hits at three sites only (duplicate purchase receipts, replayed supply-drop opens, replayed contract claims); an outbox retry appears there only if it happens to be one of those three and only if the original had already been recorded.
